title: hkdf-sha256 — case shape (v0.1)
description: Pins one byte-level case for protocol::derive_subkey — the canonical HKDF-SHA-256 helper that derives every v0.1 subkey from root_key with salt=zero_32 and info='myne.v0.1 '||role. Each case fixes a (root_key, role) input pair and the 32-byte subkey the helper must produce. Role registry mirrors the type-safe Rust SubkeyRole enum (spec §3.4); only registered role strings are accepted. The Rust reference implementation lives at protocol/src/subkey.rs (main myne repository); spec contract is docs/spec/protocol.md §3.2 (HKDF construction) + §3.4 (role registry).

vector_id.description: Stable identifier of the form 'hkdf-sha256/v0.1/<descriptive-slug>'. Immutable once shipped.

input_root_key_hex.description: 32-byte root_key (hex). HKDF Extract phase consumes this as the IKM under salt=zero_32.

input_role.description: Registered role string (spec §3.4). MUST appear in protocol::SubkeyRole::role_str. Future v0.1.x revisions extend this enum + the Rust SubkeyRole enum in lockstep — additive only, immutable for existing variants. 'search-index-key' is the KEK for the vault.search blob (MYND-29, §9.6) — note it differs from the AAD role string 'search-index-blob' used by aad_search_index_blob. 'attachments-catalog-key' is the KEK for the vault.attachments catalog blob (MYND-164, §9.10); 'attachments-id-hmac' keys the HMAC-SHA-256 deriving deterministic attachment-ids (§9.9) — NOT a blob KEK; the two are the §9.10.1 domain-separation pair. 'session-state-key' is the KEK for the vault.workspace blob (MYND-254, §9.7) — it likewise differs from the AAD role string 'workspace-blob' used by aad_workspace_blob. 'personal-dictionary-key' is the KEK for the vault.dictionary blob (MYND-266, §9.13) — DISTINCT from the AAD role 'personal-dictionary-blob' used by aad_personal_dictionary_blob. 'vault-indices-key' is the KEK for the vault.indices structured-metadata blob (MYND-271, §9.8) — DISTINCT from 'search-index-key' (separate blob family) and from the AAD role 'vault-indices-blob' used by aad_vault_indices_blob. 'attachment-text-key' is the KEK for the per-attachment MYE1 extracted-text cache (MYND-328, §9.15). 'ai-embeddings-key' is the KEK for the vault.embeddings on-device AI-embedding-index blob (MYR1, MYND-453, §9.17) — DISTINCT from 'search-index-key' and 'vault-indices-key' (separate blob families) and from the AAD role 'ai-embeddings-blob' used by aad_ai_embeddings_blob. 'catalog-sync-id' derives the Phase-2 sync blob-id of the vault.attachments catalog (MYND-468, §3.4 + sync-protocol.md §8.1) — the FIRST 16 BYTES of the 32-byte output are the id; an IDENTIFIER derivation like 'attachments-id-hmac', NOT a KEK (the catalog KEK stays 'attachments-catalog-key').

informational_info_utf8_hex.description: Informational — the canonical HKDF info bytes the helper assembles from the (prefix, role) pair: '"myne.v0.1 "' (10 bytes, trailing space included) concatenated with the role string (no separator, no length prefix). Hex-encoded UTF-8 bytes. Not consumed by the runner — verified implicitly via the expected_subkey_hex assertion; carried so independent implementers verifying their port assemble the same info parameter can do so without re-parsing the spec. Optional per-vector.

expected_subkey_hex.description: Full 32-byte subkey output (hex, lowercase, no 0x prefix). Implementations decode input_root_key_hex + input_role, run their derive_subkey equivalent, hex-encode the output, compare byte-equal.
